title: Second Battle of La Puerta
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of La Puerta", at revision 1370736349, opens: "The Second Battle of La Puerta was fought between Royalists of the Spanish Empire and the Second Republic of Venezuela on 15 June 1814. It was a crushing defeat for the Republicans and a turning point in the war that led to the fall of the Second Republic of Venezuela." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889067, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1814 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
